messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a contributor roster for the partner evidence handoff for ACME Marketplace listing. Who's actually owning upload/redaction/attest? Need by EOD tomorrow.

samir: I can own security review + pen-test witness scheduling. Will need contact for SI and HW SI.

jordan: I can do the S3 presign pipeline + manifest generation. @maya can you confirm bucket and TTL policy?

nina: I'll take redaction for PII and firmware blobs. Need the redaction checklist from legal though.

maya: @jordan bucket is marketplace-evidence/partners/acme. TTL 90 days by default unless compliance asks otherwise. Can we presign for 7 days?

jordan: Yes 7d presign works. I'll push a small script to the evidence repo. Example presign usage:
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/acme/evidence.tar.gz --expires-in 604800

leo: tagging question — should we include vendor, artifact-type, and attestation-version tags on upload? :thinking_face: 

samir: yes — required tags: vendor=acme, artifact_type={soc_report|pen_trace|firmware}, attestation=v1. Put them in the manifest too.

maya: For ownership table, let's map roles: Partner contact: ACME - reps@acme.com (they upload?), Upload owner: jordan, Redaction owner: nina, Security reviewer: samir, Legal attestation: nina (coord w/ legal), Integrations SME: leo. Can we get approvals from each?

jordan: ack. I'll create a GH issue and a minimal CSV roster. Will include S3 path and presign link field.

nina: ack for redaction. Legal, @courtney (not in thread) will need to sign the checklist — can someone ping her?

maya: I'll ping courtney in #legal. Also note: for SOC reports we need a signed cover letter. @samir can you confirm required signer?

samir: Usually vp-security or CISO on their side. We'll ask ACME to attach scan of signed letter to the bundle. If they can't, we accept notarized attestation with additional verification step.

jordan: FYI the manifest schema I'll use (CSV headers): upload_path, filename, vendor, artifact_type, presign_url, presign_expires, uploader, redaction_status, reviewer, notes

leo: For hardware firmware, nina — do you want the raw firmware or a hashed artifact + debug log? Hash+log preferred from a security POV.

nina: Hash + full debug log + release notes. We will not store raw firmware unless absolutely required — sensitive.

maya: Good. Also timeline: partner to deliver artifacts by next Wed. We need internal review complete by the following Mon to hit the marketplace embargo.

dataroom-bot: New upload link created: https://dataroom.redwood.ai/acme/marketplace-evidence ; presign quota remaining: 120/day

samir: Let's also add a small pen-test witness window: week after artifacts arrive. I'll schedule with the external vendor and ACME.

jordan: I'll drop the roster CSV into repo and tag @maya @samir. Link to GH issue once done.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone can't take their role speak up now or I'll reassign. :thumbsup:
